rca_of_the_issue: importer.process_directory keys version groups on family_key(filename); two source docs describing the same bot under different filenames (e.g. 'Cannabis w Alegraic Functions' vs 'Hemp for Masking' vs 'Leafly IQ ...') land in different families, so both become separate active bots with the identical production text. The record's sha256 content_hash is only persisted in versions[] and used for import-time duplicate detection, never for collapsing the seeded catalog. Fix: after grouping, collapse bots whose production content_hash matches and demote extras to status='library', then re-run migrate with a new meta flag.
